title: Classified lists of uncorrelated targets since the 1960s
place_text: Earth orbit; US Space Force, NASA, ESA

tellings.quote: What I didn't know is that there's apparently since the early 1960s, there were something called uncorrelated targets.

plain: An astronomer named Beatriz Villarroel tells podcast host Jesse Michels that she learned that since the early 1960s there have been secret lists of 'uncorrelated targets', objects tracked in orbit around Earth that could not be matched to anything known. She ties this to space agencies and the US military's space branch. If true, it would mean unexplained objects have been quietly logged around our planet for decades.
